messages:
maria: PSI dropped adapter 'psi-v1-lora.tar.gz' + eval instructions. Can we do a quick compat + quant sanity run today? cc @jun @ashok :eyes:
jun: on it. what's base model? psi says 'redwood-7b-v0.9' (no special tokenizer changes)
sophie: I'll run the smoke eval pack (psi_smoke_100) across merge variants. plan: merge -> q4_0 -> q4_k_maybe -> run eval.
ashok: for quant we'll try bitsandbytes q4_0 and q4_k_m, and q4_1 as fallback. also check KV cache restore for 1-2 tokens skip.
jun: starting merge dry-run now. command:
```bash
git checkout feature/lora-merge-psi
python merge_lora.py --base redwood-7b-v0.9 --adapter psi-v1-lora.tar.gz --out merged-psi-v1
```
jun: merge succeeded locally, no shape mismatches. next: quantize via bnb.
jun: quant outputs:
```
q4_0: size 3.9GB
q4_k_m: size 3.7GB
q4_1: size 4.1GB
```
eval-runner: starting quick eval psi_smoke_100 on merged-psi-v1 q4_0
eval-runner: progress 100/100
eval-runner: metrics: acc=0.918, bleu=31.2, latency_p95=240ms
sophie: acc drop vs base= -0.9% (within threshold). latency ok.
maria: nice. any generative quality regressions? sample diffs?
jun: sample diff looks fine, a couple of truncation issues on long context. likely KV cache padding. I'll run KV debug.
ashok: rerun q4_k_m fallback, see if truncation changes.
eval-runner: q4_k_m metrics: acc=0.916, bleu=30.9, latency_p95=225ms
sophie: q4_k less accuracy but better latency. tradeoff may be okay.
maria: customer prefers latency under 250ms, but quality must be within 1.5%. q4_0 meets both.
jun: next steps: 1) run full psi_regression_1k with q4_0 2) add tokenizer edgecases 3) KV cache fix PR if needed.
sophie: I'll upload quick report + artifacts to https://redwood.internal/eng-ml/lets/psi/1768456789
maria: thanks team. target to hand off to QE by EOD tomorrow. :thumbsup:
ci-bot: created ticket ML-PSI-452 for follow-ups
maria: tagging @ashok for deployment plan once QE passes
ashok: noted, will prepare canary config and fallback to redwood-7b-v0.9 on errors :gear:
